SELECT w.id, w.code, w.source, w.status, m.code AS productCode, m.name AS productName, u.name AS unitName, w.planned_qty AS plannedQty, w.create_time AS createTime FROM workorder w LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id = w.product_id LEFT JOIN unit_measure u ON u.id = m.unit_id
AND w.code LIKE #{filter.workorderCodePattern} ESCAPE '!'
AND m.code LIKE #{filter.productCodePattern} ESCAPE '!'
AND w.status != #{cancelledStatus} AND w.status = #{filter.status}
ORDER BY w.id DESC

SELECT e.workorder_id AS workorderId, SUM(c.effective_qty) AS quantity, COUNT(c.id) AS factCount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.execution_id) AS executionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.effective_qty IS NULL OR c.effective_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalidCount, MAX(c.recorded_at) AS lastCompletedAt FROM mes_production_execution e JOIN mes_execution_completion c ON c.execution_id = e.id WHERE e.workorder_id IN #{id} GROUP BY e.workorder_id

SELECT e.workorder_id AS workorderId, d.defect_qty AS declaredQty, MAX(t.attribution_type) AS attribution, d.destination_type AS destinationType, COALESCE(SUM(t.scrap_qty), 0) AS scrapQty, COALESCE(SUM(t.failed_qty), 0) AS failedQty, COALESCE(SUM(t.recovered_qty), 0) AS recoveredQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.action_type IN (#{allocateAction}, #{cancelAllocateAction}) THEN t.rework_qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS allocatedReworkQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.action_type IN (#{startAction}, #{cancelStartAction}) THEN t.rework_qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS startedQty, COALESCE(SUM(t.processed_qty), 0) AS processedQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.action_type = 'RETURN_NODE' THEN t.rework_qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returnedQty, COALESCE(SUM(t.transfer_qty), 0) AS transferredQty FROM mes_production_execution e JOIN mes_production_defect d ON d.execution_id = e.id LEFT JOIN mes_quality_treatment t ON t.declaration_id = d.declaration_id AND t.declaration_revision = d.revision_no AND t.execution_id = d.execution_id WHERE e.workorder_id IN #{id} AND d.record_action != #{voidAction} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_production_defect newer WHERE newer.declaration_id = d.declaration_id AND newer.revision_no > d.revision_no) GROUP BY e.workorder_id, d.declaration_id, d.revision_no, d.defect_qty, d.destination_type
